name: Kalaari Capital
identity_check: Kalaari Capital at kalaari.com: an early-stage, technology-focused Indian venture firm in Bengaluru (Navigator Building, ITPB, Whitefield Road), active since 2006 (Inc42 2015: it began as IndoUS Venture Partners) and led by Managing Director Vani Kola. Its site names the SEBI-registered AIF Kalaari Capital Partners India IV (IN/AIF2/19-20/0695), investment manager KCP Managers LLP. Confirmed by domain, the firm's own About, Teams, Portfolio, Seek Funding and Investor Relations pages, and round press (Entrackr, Inc42) quoting the same partners. CXXO (cxxo.kalaari.com) is Kalaari's own women-founder carve-out, not a separate firm; 'Kalaari Ventures' in one Inc42 article is the same firm. Not any other business using the Kalaari name.

thesis_text.value: Bengaluru early-stage VC writing first cheques of about INR 4-40 crore from pre-seed to Series A, preferring to lead. Backs consumer tech, deep tech and enterprise AI; 2025-26 deals are mostly agentic enterprise AI, cybersecurity, space and rare-earth-free motors. Published an AI-in-manufacturing thesis (June 2026) inviting vertical-AI founders. CXXO, a $10M carve-out, backs women-led startups.

open_items: No explicit statement found on investing in US-domiciled / flipped companies. requires_us_entity = 'no' rests on the portfolio of Indian, mostly Bengaluru-based companies (Matters.AI, MeshDefend, HireBound, Digantara, Hyperbots) and CXXO's 'Built in India, for India, with global ambition'. Several portfolio companies sell mainly into the US (Hyperbots, Pype AI, HireBound's India-US staffing corridor); whether Kalaari invests into a Delaware parent with an Indian subsidiary is unconfirmed. Ask the firm directly.
Pype AI domicile unclear: Inc42's database profile says 'headquartered in San Francisco' but names the legal entity SINGULARITY CORP PRIVATE LIMITED; Entrackr gives no HQ. hq_country left null.

Fund IV final size and close date not found; no Fund V announcement found (one web search). Fund I (2006, as IndoUS Venture Partners) size not found. A YourStory article (Sep 2012) titled 'Kalaari Announces Closing of its $150M Fund' returned HTTP 403, so Fund II's $160M (Inc42 2015) could not be checked against it. SEC EDGAR refused the request; Form D filings for Kalaari Capital Partners II/III not read.

Fund names: 'Kalaari Capital Fund II' is a label given here for the $160M 2012 fund; Inc42 names only Kalaari Capital Partners III and the Opportunity Fund. The Opportunity Fund's $75M is a 2015 target; no close found.
AUM not found on any fetched page.

Sector fit: Kalaari published 'AI in Manufacturing: The Silent Revolution Reshaping Factories' (16 Jun 2026), mapping factory-AI layers (data infrastructure, predictive maintenance, production optimisation, quality inspection, LLM copilots for maintenance teams) and inviting vertical-AI founders to write in; also 'Physical AI and the Deployment Problem' (16 Jun 2026). No factory-operations AI company appears in the 73-company portfolio list; nearest are Peer Robotics (cobots, 2022), Agnext (AI quality assessment, 2019), IndustryBuying (industrial supplies e-commerce, 2015) and Modulus Housing (factory-built construction).
Most Kalaari blog posts carry re-stamped dates (28-30 Apr 2026) from a site rebuild, so round dates come from press, not the blog.

Rounds not recorded: SuperBryn $1.2M pre-seed via CXXO (Inc42 database lists 9 Dec 2025, investors 'Cxxo +5 More'; no press article fetched); Clean Electric $6M Series A, Convin $6.5M Series A and Agrim $17.3M Series B (Kalaari posts only, with re-stamped dates; Convin's was mid-2024); Hyperbots $2M seed led by Kalaari (2024, mentioned only in the Series A article). YourStory pages returned 403 (NudgeBee).
Matters.AI amount: a search snippet suggested Inc42 reported a different figure ($4.7M); that Inc42 article was not fetched, so the Entrackr Rs 55 Cr is recorded.

Partner focus: only Sampath P (AI and DeepTech) and Pranav Koshal (DeepTech) state a focus. Jayraj Bharat Patel's listed portfolio is AI applications (Pype AI, SuperBryn, Pascal AI, Hyperbots, HireBound) but no focus is stated. Harshit Kumar covers ConsumerTech (not listed). Sampath is the only Partner below the Managing Director on the current team page.
Kalaari's NudgeBee post names Rackspace as an early enterprise deployment; NudgeBee's HQ not stated in fetched pages.

Pitching: the /seek-funding-form application (read, not submitted) asks for founder names, problem, evidence, primary customer, company stage, traction, capital to raise and risks; it has no country-of-incorporation field. The firm also lists pitch and deeptech email addresses (not recorded). Seek Funding page: most journeys complete in about 4-6 weeks from the first call.
